primitives.name: Kickoff Boundary Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: At kick-off, if the ball goes out of bounds before it is touched by any player, it shall be brought back and be kicked off again.
primitives.assumptions: Ball trajectory is deterministic; player contact is binary.

layer2.mapping: Discrete event trigger for scrimmage reset maps to Bayesian prior update on possession.
layer2.telemetry: Ball exit point relative to field boundaries

primitives.name: Repeated Out-of-Bounds Kick
primitives.verbatim_quote: If it is kicked out of bounds a second time, it shall go to the opponents, who shall put it in play by a scrimmage at their 40-yard line, equidistant from the side lines.
primitives.assumptions: Second kick failure triggers fixed positional reset.

layer2.mapping: State transition from repeated failure to opponent possession via fixed rule-based reset.
layer2.telemetry: Cumulative kick-out count and scrimmage location

primitives.name: Possession by Contact
primitives.verbatim_quote: But if it strikes any player who is entitled to get it and then goes out of bounds, it shall belong to the player who first obtains possession of'it.
primitives.assumptions: Player entitlement is defined by game state.

layer2.mapping: Contact-based possession logic mirrors probabilistic outcome assignment in Bayesian inference.
layer2.telemetry: Player contact sequence and final ball location
